items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: We used to sit down together at one of his lady friends' house. In the backyard, two clarinets, Pico on one and me on one, and played together.

ctx.x: To be played that night. It had to be played that night. They didn't have no copy for the Clarenters. You don't remember what job that was. No, that was way from here.

out of town. Around, I believe it was somewhere around Philadelphia. Yeah, I believe it was in Philadelphia somewhere that happened. Right on the job they transposed it and the clarinet played that night, played the variation. That's where they got the variation from. But later on, like I said, they brought it up here. But me, I know part of the fact that Pico didn't. Because I heard Pico play all these days, I was a kid coming up under him. We used to sit down together at one of his lady friends' house. In the…
Yeah. Did he have that same clarinet in those days, the one with the turned up end bell on it?
